title: VDensHO1 firmware asset and MCU-evidence boundary

interpretation: No .hex/.mot/.s19/.srec/.bin/.rom/.eep/.fw/.img/.upd asset attributable to VDensHO1/20C2 was found.
The vsmGWG99Native DLLs are Windows host-side Vitosoft drivers and are not boiler regulation firmware.
The verified Vitosoft archive therefore cannot currently provide a controller image for direct static firmware analysis.

m16c_reference_trace.description_excerpt: EFh Timer- Fehler. Alle Timer des M16C stehen still.
interpretation: Vitosoft contains a generic reset-cause event whose description references M16C.
The event has no EventTypeGroup membership, including no VDensHO1 membership.
Do not infer that the local 20C2 regulation uses an M16C solely from this text.
A local PCB photo or other device-specific source remains required before naming the MCU family.

public_board_provenance_to_verify_later: GG1/WB2A regulation replacement families include 7823830 and successor 7825241.
A publicly reported GG1 PCB carries 7184367 405334100.
These part numbers are comparison targets only until the user's installed board is photographed.
next_steps: Inspect exact local regulation PCB and MCU marking when physical access/photos are available.
Use public GG1 board photos only as comparison references, not local proof.
Proceed with physical coding-plug EEPROM correlation when the reader is available.
Do not attempt broad RAM/flash sweeps or infer program-flash accessibility from ordinary 16-bit VS2 addresses.
